contentText:
Earlier on Tuesday, TikTok experienced some issues, with videos, search results, favorites, and other features not loading as they usually do. Videos sometimes wouldn't load in the For You feed on my iPhone, and search results occasionally didn't show up as expected in the app on iOS or Android, or on the web. Even trying to pull up a profile would show a blank page, while links to videos are dead in the water too. However, as of 3:45PM ET or so, things appear to be working normally again.

Downdetector showed around 25,000 reports of issues at around 2:56PM ET, and many people on social media were saying that TikTok was down for them .
